children: PDS Biotechnology updated its corporate presentation highlighting strong Phase 2 signals for PDS0301 and recent September 2026 financing led by Nant Capital.
PDS0301 + chemotherapy showed 71.4% objective response rate at 6 months in NCI-led Phase 2 for MSS/pMMR mCRC with liver mets.
Approximately 80% 24-month survival reported for PDS0301 + chemotherapy; median OS currently exceeding 34 months.
More than 380 patients have been dosed across Phase 1 & 2 programs for PDS0301.
September 2026 financing led by Nant Capital; Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong joined the board and a registrational Phase 3 protocol for PDS0301 is in design.
PDS0101 (Versamune HPV16 vaccine) reported 39.3-month median OS with pembrolizumab in 1L HPV16+ recurrent/metastatic HNSCC; VERSATILE-003 holds FDA Fast Track.
